_comment: Findings from analysing the mods' own packs (curator/analyze_pack.py; results in curator/raw/packs/<mod>.json). Field overrides like the other followup files; applied after the research pass because they rest on the files themselves.

playAs.note: Only her own campaign: her battle transformation at stage 6

relations+.note: The pack declares seu_miaoying_submod_extension.pack as a dependency (and Soil's Miao Ying units, which Soil's Corrupted Units or the merged pack provide).

The merged pack holds the Miao Ying and Azazel packs of Soil's Corrupted Units with the same scripts (corrupted_barracks.lua, corrupted_startup.lua): load one or the other. Soil's Kislev pack does not work with the Azazel units either.
Holds the Miao Ying and Azazel packs of Soil's Corrupted Units, so mods that need those units work with it (Soil's Kislev pack is not part of it).
An older upload (2023) of Lazy's Morathi stage 3 and 4 reskins: Lazy's Corrupted Reskins Morathi contains the same files (same table and model paths) and overrides them.
Contains the stage 3 and 4 reskins of the 2023 Nexus upload (same files).

relations.note: Soft requirement: without the mod, an NSFW skin is loaded by default; with the mod, 16 variants are selectable
Not needed: the pack already contains Beautiful Neferata's models and textures (22 identical files). Using both only adds a second copy.
Not needed: the pack brings its own versions of this mod's look. Loaded above Naughty Neferata, it would replace Neferata's default mesh definition and portraits and break the variants.

loadOrder.note: Only matters if the two Steam Neferata mods are kept installed: Naughty Neferata must win over both.

knownIssues: Self-contained: the two Steam Neferata mods the page names were merged into this pack and are not needed. If they stay active, load Naughty Neferata above them.
mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01: (X)_Naughty_Nef_XXX.pack, 174 files, no declared dependencies; all 138 model/material/texture references resolve to the pack itself (92) or the base game (38), none only to the Steam mods. 22 of 23 files shared with Beautiful Neferata are byte-identical; all 6 shared with 3809129102 differ (its vmp_neferata.variantmeshdefinition and portraits).

installNotes: The page says it probably needs Mixu's Unlocker, but the pack does not refer to it: it only uses base-game keys (Wood Elves building culture, the Carcassonne landmark slot).
knownIssues: Adds a Wood Elf landmark in the Carcassonne landmark slot. Corrupted Landmarks does not use that slot (checked); other landmark mods are unchecked.
mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-25677.json): db + text only (16 tables, 4 .loc); all keys are base-game keys (wh_main_bas_brt, wh3_main_secondary_addon_landmark_carcassonne, wood_elves_city_oak_of_ages). Compared with Corrupted Landmarks (ll-30462): no shared files, no shared landmark keys (it uses 119 other landmark slots, not Carcassonne).

knownIssues: Replaces about 3,400 faction flag and banner images (ui/flags). It shares 631 of them with RS0371's Slaanesh's image and text, 19 with Lewd Flags and Loading Screens (Alarielle's Avelorn flags) and 6 with Corrupted Cathay (Miao) Flag: the mod loaded higher decides which image shows.
mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-49568.json): one pack TardBannerPackBetter-V1.00.pack, 3436 files, all under ui/flags; no dependencies.

packs.note: Two downloads with the same pack name: images only, or images and text. Install one of them.

knownIssues: Shares 631 flag images with TardBannerPackBetter (ll-49568); the mod loaded higher wins.
mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-28211.json): both zips hold EFT.pack (1863 ui, 46 text, 2 db files).

openQuestions: Relationship to the Steam original 3574561438 (spin-off/rip): usable together or incompatible - not stated.

mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-52245.json): 61 unresolved model/texture references (51 also in ll-49648). Checked in game 2026-11-01 without that collection: the model and textures are complete, so it is not needed.
installNotes: The Steam original mod ('一个申朱技能，晓模型的英雄.pack', 3574561438) is a different product; the page does not say whether both may be active together.
In custom battles she is listed as “Crusader Angel” among Grand Cathay's lords.

knownIssues: Shares 19 flag images with TardBannerPackBetter (Alarielle's Avelorn flags); the mod loaded higher wins.
mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-41124.json): 4 packs, 28 files, all under ui/.
